en: A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑toned) street scene showing a broad intersection lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century townhouses and shops. A prominent corner building with ornate gable and tall spire stands at the junction, with striped shop awnings at street level. Pedestrians and a few cyclists walk along the cobbled street. In the foreground to the right is a fenced-off garden or small square. The lower-left corner bears a caption indicating the location.
